targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    d.datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS "time",
    d.current AS "value",
    CONCAT(d.equipment, ' (', d.measuring_location, ')') AS "metric"
FROM user_equipmentcurrentdata d
WHERE
    d.form_id = 470
    AND d.equipment ILIKE '%Blower%'
    AND $__timeFilter(d.datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')
ORDER BY d.datetime ASC;
